purpose: File Search calibration for agent version 4 (the working run sheet, item 4; C8 minimisation). Phase 1 runs every question on version 3 with --show-annotations and records the raw score per question and file (scores and file names only, no passage text). The score_threshold for scenarios/larkfield/agent.json is chosen from those scores; phase 2 reruns the same questions on version 4.
data: Synthetic. No member, claim or caseload details; no claim IDs. Questions refer only to the pack's internal documents (scenarios/larkfield/data/internal/).

expectations.in_scope: retrieves the expected file with the highest score; after calibration, few or no other files
expectations.near_topic: close to the corpus but not answered by it; after calibration, ideally nothing retrieved, and the answer says the documents don't cover it
expectations.off_topic: unrelated to the corpus; after calibration, nothing retrieved
